description: Self acceptance , the game of life #selfacceptance #selflove #intentionalliving
transcript: I do not overthink and I do not over explain myself. Noance is such a gift that I allow to guide me. Flexibility reminds me that it is not my job to change anyone's mind. It is not my job to force you to see life from the lens in which I do. It is not for me to force you to see the colors that I see. I no longer try to put myself in a position where I have to over explain every detail about me in order to feel validated. I validate me.
